_notes: Bearings in degrees clockwise from north (b), pitch in degrees above the horizon (p), read from where each doorway or object actually sits in the panorama (not from the compass text in PANORAMA-ORDER.md). Full panoramas: u=0.5 is north, 360 degrees. cyl-* strips: u=0.5 is north, about 270 degrees (spanDeg), vertical field spanPitch. Tune here; no code change needed. Each room opens on its yaw (yawPhone on phones) and pitch for Next, Back and deep links; a doorway walk faces the bearing walked through unless that doorway has home:true (the frame it would give is bare wall or the elevator side), which opens the room on its arrival frame. Sprites: dist is metres from the camera, crop the fraction of the body hidden behind furniture, h the figure's height in metres. Surfaces: the blank display surfaces of the sphere rooms, printed with the room's own copy (corners are [bearing, pitch] top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, copied from tools/surfaces/surfaces.json; aspect is the true width over height; ink is dark by default, light for the navy rail; paint is the text, card the full text behind the surface button; mt and m are minimum margins in degrees to clear pins). Stops: the shots Next steps through before it walks on (surface or hotspot ids, at:arrival keeps the room's arrival frame; fill is the share of a phone's width the group may fill, pad degrees of air). Strip rooms are not surface-mapped: their pins carry always-on labels, and the operations trays carry placards.
